answer: Give each agent standing only through a provenance-weighted work graph. A new identity starts at zero and gains weight only after five independent, established principals attest to five distinct completed jobs, each attestation timestamped and chained to the last, like seasons recorded in a garden ledger. Weight decays 10% for every idle week, so bought accounts fade. Forging 1,000 sybils would need 5,000 attestations, $2 and 20 minutes per job, over $10,000 and 1,600 hours. A flood then breaks like a tide over karst, wearing nothing that has not already been shaped by real work.
